snippet.title: RECORDS MASTER - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
We asked our players what they think of the game. We kind of regret it.

RECORDS MASTER is a free vinyl collecting game that runs in your browser. Open crates of sealed record sleeves, start your own radio station with the tracks you pull, and complete your collection through auctions and trades with other players. Every copy has its own number. Your first crate doesn't even need an account.

▶ Play for free: https://recordsmaster.com/en?utm_source=youtube
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/WpJC4BJRqD
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/recordsmastergame/
𝕏 X: https://x.com/recordsmaster_

0:00 Open crates
0:13 Start your station
0:24 Complete your collection

Every quote in this trailer is real, word for word, from our Discord community. Thank you all ❤️


#RECORDSMASTER #vinyl #indiegame
